predecessors.name: Min
predecessors.text: Jian Prefecture (Jianzhou), Wang Yanzheng's power base; read as the Nanping country

successors.name: Min
successors.text: Fujian outside Fu Prefecture: Jian, Zhang, Quan and Ting prefectures under Yin in 944

ledger.x: 943: Wang Yanzheng declares the empire of Yin at Jian.
944: Zhang, Quan and Ting submit to Yin.
945: Yin is folded back into Min.
945: the Yin state ends as Wang Yanzheng takes the Min title.

wars.name: Yin secession and Min civil war
wars.outcome: Yin held Jian from 943 and Zhang, Quan and Ting from 944; Wang Xi was assassinated by Zhu Wenjin in 944; Wang Yanzheng reunited Min by February or March 945.

certainty.note: Prefecture-level reading only; no page gives a boundary, and the pages disagree on which side of Min Jian lay.

sources.title: Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period
